evidence.note: CONFIRMED. Claim: 'ddflow gate status' renders a recorded SuiteBusy unavailable reason verbatim (the present-tense 'blocked on pid ... since ... you are #k in the queue' line from ddflow/services/suitelock.py SuiteBusy.__str__, recorded in runner.py run_command_gate), so it reads as a live queue entry long after the wait ended. Mechanism: services/gates/reasons.py _unavailable_reasons joins rec.reason untouched with no rec.at timestamp. Probe: regression test tests/test_gate_status_suite_wait_timeout.py asserts the note carries 'recorded <at>' + 'a past timeout' + 're-run the gate'; on the unfixed code 3 tests FAIL (reason rendered with no timestamp/framing), on the fixed code all 6 pass.

Read claimed worktree AGENTS.md work-queue rules and the reproduced guidance (r-gemini-key-load: export GEMINI_API_KEY before ddflow review). Applied: claim before edit (claimed fix-Bc53afb94b4), regression test before fix, honest unavailable-vs-pass distinction, cross-family reviewers (gemini/google + grok/xai != deepseek author).

Minimal change in ddflow/services/gates/reasons.py: _SUITE_WAIT regex + _past_suite_wait(); _unavailable_reasons appends 'recorded <at>; a past timeout -- re-run the gate' when the reason opens with the full-suite 'blocked on ... since ...' line. New regression test tests/test_gate_status_suite_wait_timeout.py (6 tests). Verifies FAIL on unfixed (3 failures) and PASS on fixed. ruff check + format clean. Commit aa50e100a.

chunk_findings.detail: `_past_suite_wait` appends the only text that marks the wait as finished, then `_unavailable_reasons` still slices to `WHY_CHARS` (200) from the front. A SuiteBusy line already embeds a filesystem path, so a reason of 150 characters such as `blocked on pid 989929 / PS-snapshot of [REDACTED:path] since 02:12:11, you are #2 in the queue` plus the 63-character ` (recorded 2026-11-05 02:12; a past timeout -- re-run the gate)` is 213 characters and becomes `...since 02:12:11, you are #2 in the queue (recorded 20...`. The present-tense queue wording remains and both `a past timeout` and `re-run the gate` are dropped, which is the Bc53afb94b4 misread for any holder path that pushes the collapsed reason past 137 characters.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/gates/reasons.py:45

chunk_findings.detail: The past-timeout note is gated on `_SUITE_WAIT.match(rec.reason)`, which does not cross newlines, while the string actually printed is the whitespace-collapsed `text`. Given reason `"blocked on pid 989929 / PS-snapshot of /repo since\r\n02:12:11, you are #2 in the queue"` (or a bare `\n` before the time), the match fails, `_suite_wait_note` is skipped, and `gate status` still prints the present-tense queue line with no recorded time and no "past timeout" note — the same misread Bc53afb94b4 is about. `split()` already treats that newline as ignorable whitespace, so the displayed text is exactly the live-looking form the regex was meant to catch.
